slides.title: What Happened
slides.body: Economists expected about 59,000 to 65,000. Unemployment slipped to 4.1% and wages rose 3.1% from a year ago (BLS, Nov 6).

slides.title: The Key Numbers
slides.subtitle: Monthly job gains (thousands)
slides.body: Aug and Sep were revised up by 84,000 combined. *Consensus estimate.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Strong hiring gives the Fed room to raise rates. Odds of a Dec 9 hike jumped from about 67% to 85%, then eased to 78%. These are market estimates, not decisions.
